item.text: I’m building the Chapter 1B evidence set around the actual 2022 risk-bearing choices: nuclear rhetoric, command posture, treaty/inspection behavior, and whether nuclear capability was used to shield the Ukraine war. I’ll open a broad first-pass set, then trim to the strongest cross-chapter sources and keep the rest as discovery-only or discard them as duplicates/low-value.
